item.title: Membership Drive
item.description: Serving the area as a hyper-local media hub is contingent upon community support. We raise funds in several different ways, and one of the most important means of support is through memberships. By becoming a member, you can hep support all of the work behind the scenes. That is, all of the work that goes into putting the thousands of hours of new local programming out onto our various platforms - TV channels, streaming app, video on demand, and now also podcasting (and soon, radio!). item.title: WLUD Community Radio
item.description: In 2024, we received a license from the FCC to build a low power FM community radio station. We have a team of enthusiastic volunteers working to make it happen. And thanks to their efforts, along with the support from the Town of Ludlow and Okemo Mountain Resort, we are inching our way towards making this a reality! item.title: Updated Staffing & Office Hours
item.description: We are BACK to our old office hours! Over the past Summer, we scaled back those hours, while we were operating with reduced staffing. We are please to announce that we are back up to previous staffing levels, after bringing Willem up to full time. And as a reflection of that, we've extended hours back to where they were prior to last Summer. item.title: WLUD Community Radio Update!
item.description: A lot is still happening behind the scenes to get WLUD community radio off the ground. In March 2027, WLUD will need to be broadcasting locally on 93.3 FM, and we know we want to be streaming online well before then, so that we can get the operational workflow down, and have time to get the programming in order, show hosts & DJs trained, and all of the other things that will inevitably come up.
